entries.title: Automating detection tuning requests with Kibana cases
entries.description: Learn how to automate detection rule tuning requests in Elastic Security. This guide shows how to add custom fields to Cases, create a rule to detect tuning needs, and use a webhook to create a frictionless feedback loop between analysts and detection engineers.
